body.name: One-unseen-row compatible RSCM class
body.construction:
\(Mone=\{M: M\text{ is a finite RSCM over }S\text{ and }G;\ M\text{ induces
the source groundings }Rsrc\text{ and target grounding }\rho\text{ encoded by
}Ictx;\text{ all distinct exogenous variables are mutually independent; no
ground endogenous variable has an exogenous relational parent; no
non-relational exogenous variable is a parent of two distinct ground endogenous
variables; mechanisms are shared by type--context key; }M\text{ reproduces
}Psrc;\ M\text{ uses the rows }K\text{ recovered from positive-probability
source parent contexts; and }M\text{ has exactly one unrestricted
target-relevant binary row at }rstar\}\).
